description: This file defines the TimeReportAPI class within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically for handling time-related reports via API endpoints. It maps report types to corresponding classes, validates report names, and provides API documentation annotations.

classes.name: TimeReportAPI
classes.description: API class providing access to various time reports, extending the base ReportAPI class and mapping report identifiers to their respective classes.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and instantiates the appropriate report class based on the report name parameter, validating the input against a predefined map and throwing a BadRequestException if invalid.
